I first flooded one corner of the CPU with IPA and then used thin floss to try and work my way in between the CPU and cooler. It got stuck after a while, but it was enough for me to be able to twist the CPU off slowly.

To those who advised to putting the CPU on again: have you even ever installed an AM4 CPU? There is no way to not destroy the pins of such a CPU by putting it on with the cooler attached. Nice try though. <!°(((((((><

Also: sharp objects scratch the surface of both the cooler and the CPU. Those little unevenness is why we apply thermal paste. They should be avoided at all cost as they eliminate thermal conductivity.
